channel.title: The Ottawa Citizen - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Ottawa Citizen (ottawacitizen.com)

item.title: Ottawa Senators extinguish the Calgary Flames in 4-1 win to move closer to playoff picture
item.description: The Senators moved to within four points of second wildcard spot in the East

item.title: Can psilocybin ease distress in the dying? Research shows promise
item.description: Ottawa researchers are optimistic about early results showing psychedelic microdoses can ease psychological distress in palliative patients.

item.title: Jeff Leiper — 'to the female mayor'? | Opinion
item.description: Brigitte Pellerin: The Ottawa city councillor only has three words in French on his election signs, and he got them wrong — twice.

item.title: Where does every city councillor stand on four day return-to-office? We asked them
item.description: Many councillors voiced opposition to the four-day in-office mandate from the federal government, others pointed to the city's model, while others side-stepped the question to discuss OC Transpo's struggles.

item.title: Stutzle shines, Cozens stays hot in Senators' win over Flames
item.description: Tim Stutzle dazzled with the puck all night long, Dylan Cozens scored again, Linus Ullmark was sharp in goal and the Ottawa Senators defeated the Calgary Flames 4-1 to move within four points of the Boston Bruins for the final wild card spot in the Eastern Conference.

item.title: Algonquin program cancellations a blow to Ottawa's economy, business and arts groups say
item.description: Arts and business leaders say events ranging from major music festivals to neighbourhood beer fests will be affected.

item.title: O-Train Line 1 numbers remain unchanged, casting doubt on East Extension spring opening
item.description: Rather than focusing on incremental increases, OC Transpo says it is now looking toward the return of the full fleet.

item.title: No more deals: It's up to these Ottawa Senators to make a playoff push
item.description: "Even before we went on this stretch, I still had belief in the team," GM Steve Staios said Friday.

item.title: Plenty of calls, but opts for no further trade action for the Ottawa Senators
item.description: "We took the approach with this deadline that it was an opportunity, like always, to try and make our team better."

item.title: OPP arrest trio in police impersonation fraud case
item.description: Two men and a woman were apprehended in Clarence-Rockland following what police alleged was a fraud at a residence in Hawkesbury.
